title: Figure 5: Energy released from ground state suppression of hydrogenic atom in microcavity
description: Two side-by-side energy-versus-radius curves: left shows a free-space Bohr orbit radius rb with a red wavy arrow labeled "E_out" indicating released energy; right shows a suppressed orbit radius rb' between two plates with resonant wavelength λ ~ 1/20 μm, with vertical axis labeled "ENERGY" and horizontal axis r. Caption: "Figure 5. Energy Released from Ground State Suppression of Hydrogenic Atom in a Microcavity."
